spans.s:
1 A pedlar, hawker.
--2
A carrier of loads on a pole.

वैवर्ण्यं [विवर्णस्य भावः ष्यञ्]
1
Change of colour or complexion,
paleness.
--2 Difference, diversity.
--3 Deviation from caste.

वैवस्वतः [विवस्वतोऽपत्यं अण्]
1 N. of
the seventh Manu who is supposed
to preside over the present age; see
under Manu; वैवस्वतो मनुर्नाम माननीयो
मनीषिणां

.
--3 N. of
Agni.
--4 One of the eleven Rudras.
--5 The planet Saturn.
--तं The
present age or Manvantara, as
presided over by Manu Vaivasvata or
the seventh Manu.

1 The southern quarter.
--2 N. of Yamunā.

.
--कः --कं A marriage, wedding.
--कः The father of a son's wife or
daughter's husband.
